chunks: And besides these two, there are two other gardens.

key_terms.دُونِهِمَا: besides them / in addition to them

ai.seo_question: What are the two gardens mentioned in Surah Ar-Rahman besides the first two?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often interpreted as referring to the two gardens of the Prophet Muhammad and Imam Ali, or the two gardens of the two types of believers, highlighting the spiritual hierarchy of Paradise. The mention of 'besides them' (min dunihi) underscores the infinite nature of divine bounty, where each level of reward reveals further layers of bliss. This structure reflects the Shia emphasis on the Ahl al-Bayt as the primary recipients of divine grace and the model for spiritual attainment.
